focus.jtag: Monday rallied to a Dow record, oil kept sliding on Iran talks, futures green again — but 10Y near 1.5-yr high and NFP Friday
focus.jnote: The friendly tape carried into Tuesday. Monday saw a broad tech-led rally — the S&P closed +1.48% at 7,600.50 and the Dow set a record high — as oil kept sliding on hopes of a Strait of Hormuz reopening deal. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the U.S. and Iran could reach an agreement Tuesday or Wednesday. Equity futures are modestly green again (S&P +0.2–0.3%, Nasdaq leading), the VIX is low near 15.6, and gold is firm around $4,130. The catch: the 10-year yield is near a 1.5-year high around 4.69% with the Fed hawkish into July payrolls Friday, and a heavy earnings slate (AMD and SpaceX tonight, CAT and MCD this morning) keeps single-name gap risk live. The scanner boarded two names this morning — both with caveats to check at the open.
focus.notdown: Mega-cap AI/chips (CAT beating on AI build-out, PLTR +14% after its print) and record-setters like EA are the tape's clear bid. EA's boarded Type C ATH breakout has held two sessions above its pivot with above-average volume — the cleanest of the two names — but note EA is in a pending $55B go-private deal, which pins the stock near the offer and caps upside. Validate it holds the pivot at 9:35 before selling any bull put.
focus.notup: Rate-sensitive and long-duration names stay pressured by a 10-year near a 1.5-year high, and any hot NFP could add to that. But selling bear calls into a risk-on, oil-relief, record-setting tape carries squeeze risk on any friendly headline — and the scanner boarded no bearish name today. The disciplined answer on the short side is to sell nothing new.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? Composite eased to 36 (MILD) and P(≥1% gap) is ~28% (below the 35% trigger), which clears the numeric GREEN locks. But two things hold it at YELLOW: (1) the macro backdrop is still tense — the 10Y is at a ~1.5-year high, the Fed is hawkish, and NFP Friday plus AMD/SpaceX tonight can gap the tape; and (2) both boarded names carry caveats — EA is pinned by a pending buyout and CSWC confirmed on almost no volume (0.01x). Half size, A-grade only, and validate every candidate at 9:35 ET.

Pre-market it's essentially flat (~$209.85 vs $209.91 prior close), sitting right on its record. risks: NFP · Fri 8/7 — July payrolls are the week's headliner after June printed weak. A hot print pushes yields higher; a weak one boosts cut hopes — either way, the single-biggest scheduled gap risk this week. Keep every spread's DTE clear of it.
10-year yield near a ~1.5-year high — the 10Y sits around 4.69% with the Fed talking tough. Any further rate pop pressures long-duration tech even on a risk-on tape.
AMD & SpaceX (tonight) — marquee AI/space prints in a market rewarding beats and punishing misses hard. Single-stock gap risk that can set the tone for chips; keep any semis spread clear of AMD.
EA go-private deal — the boarded Type C is pinned by a pending ~$55B buyout. Any merger-timing or regulatory headline can gap it out of its breakout range regardless of the tape.
Iran / Hormuz talks — a deal could land today or tomorrow, but nothing is signed. A breakdown or any Strait disruption sends crude and the whole tape gapping — the week's biggest tail.

earnings.intro: Q2 season is in one of its busiest stretches — Palantir and Caterpillar already beat, with AMD and SpaceX reporting after today's close, then Disney and others mid-week. With the market risk-on but rates high and NFP looming Friday, a single-stock earnings gap on top of macro is a double catalyst — keep every spread clear of its name's print. Both boarded names (EA, CSWC) have their earnings dates well outside a normal DTE.
